title: Study of the Correlation Between UltraSonography and Dual-Energy Computed Tomography Assessment of Urate Deposit
brief_summary: The objective of this research is to evaluate the correlation between DECT and US explorations performed in a routine clinical setting for the measurement of change in tophus size in gout patients after 24 months of treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of gout based on the ACR/EULAR 2015 criteria
* uricemia ≥6 mg/dL
* warranted introduction of urate-lowering therapy according to the ACR 2012 or EULAR 2016 criteria
* signature of the informed consent
* social insurance affiliation

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy or breastfeeding
* patient under legal guardianship
